translate_virtual_tools_to_phyre: translate a Virtual Tools world description dictionary into a PHYRE TaskCreator with objects and goals
convert_all_virtual_tools_tasks: convert all whitelisted Virtual Tools JSON levels into an OrderedDict of PHYRE tasks with prefixed IDs
add_container_to_scene: add a container object from segment points to a PHYRE scene with optional goal container support
flip_coordinates_left_right: flip a list of 2D coordinates or nested coordinate structures horizontally around the x-axis
rotate_2d_vector: rotate a 2D numpy vector by a given angle in radians and return the rotated vector
